motivation: WSP151 source-blind Bayes uses fixed 99 percent confidence, 8 do-observations, 5 percent observation-noise likelihood, and an explicit UNKNOWN mixture. A hidden-family mass above 2 percent mathematically prevents any prediction at 99 percent confidence, even when one causal-form hypothesis dominates.

hypotheses.H0_ceiling: For M.fit(rows,memory), q=unknown/denominator and p(x) in [q/2,1-q/2]. If q>1/50, all 64 readouts abstain. Independently recompute every prediction, with exact Fractions.
hypotheses.H1_policy: With identical four fabricated warm do actions plus four own do actions, source-free one-step expected-confidence-coverage selection increases paired confident-correct coverage versus WSP151 causal-form EIG and a frozen fixed SHA256 schedule by at least 5 percentage points over common uncharged contexts of fabricated worlds, without increasing confident errors.
hypotheses.H2_controls: If confidence gains result only from supplied OR/AND grammar, explicitly say so. ON-family versus OFF XOR/contradictory distributions and independent symbolic calculations must reveal fragility; do not infer true causal discovery.

design.inherited: Import pinned WSP151 overhypothesis.py as source-free numerical posterior; do not modify WSP151 file, grammar, confidence threshold, memory format, original prereg, prior negative results or accepted main.
design.policy: For each uncharged x, calculate expected number of WSP151's confidently predicted 64 contexts after a hypothetical binary observation y using only current 126 numerical mixture weights and UNKNOWN mass, weighting the two counterfactual counts by the learner's current own predictive P(y|x). Choose maximum, tie by context x ascending. No truth, hidden future coordinates or owner in selector.
design.exact_update: For numerical known hypothesis weight w, multiply by 19 if it predicts the hypothetical y, otherwise 1; for UNKNOWN weight u multiply by 10; this is algebraically identical up to common factor to refitting WSP151 after one additional row (2w times 19 or 1 and 20u).
design.cold: No prior updates on TRANSFER diagnostics. Construct 16 fabricated prior worlds, freeze and round-trip exact parent WSP151 memory, only use it read-only across diagnostic worlds.
design.acquisition: Eight observations per world: four common fabricated warm contexts, plus four chosen by each policy; all interventions are local invented truth functions, not protected original scored effects. Equal action budget. Do not reveal truth outside returned do rows to selectors.
design.cohorts: 12 fabricated ON worlds (six OR and six AND) +4 OFF XOR/compositional worlds, distinct namespace WSP152|FAKE| only; avoid WSP151 source namespace/seeds. No main/source original first-use.
design.comparison: Frozen EIG, deterministic fixed SHA256 tail, confidence-aware new policy. Score on intersection of all policies' unobserved contexts across 64 contexts per fabricated world, zero preview to policy.
design.metrics: Per-world paired coverage, confidently correct, confidently wrong, abstention, unknown fraction, q>0.02 blocked-world counts, wall/CPU including acquisition and scoring; nonidentifiability certificates and cold integrity; 16 worlds as paired statistical units.
design.limits: Pure Python standard library, deterministic, no paid compute, no original protected scientific first-use, no real causal claims, no production or native weights.

next: Only after engineering validation and a separately frozen prospective mechanism/source-owner admission may a new scientist-controlled independent experiment compare fully fitted CART/recurrent and symbolic controls on genuinely unfamiliar causal compositions. No direct promotion or merging.
